title: Knowledge link
description: What one character knows or believes about one key truth, and from where. Two positions are kept apart: `since`, from which paragraph the character holds it (the character's knowing), and `revealed_at`, from which paragraph a reader may be shown that the character holds it. Both are distinct from the truth's own `revealed_at` (the reader's knowing of the truth). Beliefs may be false. An optional `until` says when the character stops holding it.

stance.description: `knows`: holds the truth and is right. `believes`: holds something firmly, right or wrong. `suspects`: entertains it without commitment.

holds.description: true: the character holds the truth as stated. false: the character holds its contrary (a false belief). `knows` implies true.

since.description: Paragraph from which the character holds it, or `before_text` when the character holds it before the narrative begins.

revealed_at.description: First paragraph after which a reader may know that the character holds it. Never before the earliest evidence.

until.description: When the character stops holding it (a false belief corrected, a suspicion dropped, a secret forgotten, a death), with its own support. Absent: the text does not say the character stops holding it.

at.description: Paragraph from which the character no longer holds it (as stated by `stance` and `holds`). After `since`.

revealed_at.description: First paragraph after which a reader may know that the character stopped holding it. Never before the earliest of this object's evidence.
